clue.text: On a trip with press, it transformed cult leaders

parts.note: someone on a trip from drugs is high

indicators.note: the letters of press and it are changed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A drug trip combined with media attention has turned some people into leaders of a cult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transformed' rearranges PRESS and IT into PRIESTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Senior clergy who preside over a religion's rites lead its worship, so they are leaders of a cult in the old sense of a form of worship.

clue.text: Boring hospital doctor beset by signs of indecision

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

indicators.note: being beset means being surrounded, so the doctor sits between the two hesitations

parts.note: um and um are the noises of someone who cannot make up their mind

explanation.surface: A dull hospital medic keeps hesitating and saying 'um'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'signs of indecision' is plural, so the hesitation noise appears twice, one on each side of the doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Something monotonous and dull is tedious, lacking any variety or interest.

clue.text: Noise made by little one after end of feeding

indicators.note: the small one comes after the final letter, so it follows in the answer
the end of a word is its final letter, here taken from feeding

parts.note: a runt is the smallest animal in a litter

explanation.surface: A piglet makes a sound once it has finished feeding.
explanation.definitionFit: A short, low guttural sound, like a pig's, is a kind of noise.

clue.text: In a pretty poor sort of suit for father?

indicators.note: poor here means badly made, signalling that the letters of in a pretty are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man in a rather shabby suit is asked whether he is the father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' rearranges IN A PRETTY. The legal sense of suit, a lawsuit, is hidden behind the clothing picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawsuit to establish who fathered a child is called by this name, so it is a type of suit concerning a father.

clue.text: Measure edge

definitions.meaning: a unit of length, one twelfth of a foot
to move forward slowly and by small amounts

explanation.surface: Measure edge
explanation.definitionFit: It is an imperial unit of length, and as a verb it means to creep forward little by little.

clue.text: Squeal about fine increasing

indicators.note: the informer word goes round the other, surrounding it

parts.note: to squeal is to inform on someone, to sing in criminal slang
well means fine, in good health

explanation.surface: Someone protests about a fine that keeps going up.
explanation.walkthrough: Squeal is slang for informing, as is sing; it surrounds WELL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something growing larger in size or volume is expanding or getting bigger.

clue.text: This girl owns up about artist

indicators.note: the turned word goes round the artist abbreviation
in a down clue up means read from the bottom, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: has means owns or possesses
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword staple for artist

explanation.surface: A girl confesses something concerning a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' signals reading upwards; the reversal comes before 'about' wraps it round the artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A common woman's first name, so it serves as a particular girl.

clue.text: Menu as set must include starter of bass or ray

indicators.note: the rearranged letters must take in the next piece
set means arranged or put in order, signalling the letters of menu as are reworked
the starter of a word is its first letter, here from bass

explanation.surface: A set menu has to offer fish, either bass or ray, as a first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set' rearranges MENU AS to SUNEAM, and 'must include' puts B from bass inside. 'ray' looks like fish but means a beam of light.
explanation.definitionFit: A beam of sunlight is a narrow shaft of light, which is what a ray is.

clue.text: Urges simple reforms covering university — and succeeded

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go round, covering, the abbreviation for university
reforms means makes again in a new shape, so the letters of simple are rearranged

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for succeeded

explanation.surface: Simple changes at a university succeeded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reforms' rearranges SIMPLE and 'covering' puts U inside to make the singular; S is added at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Urges and sudden inclinations to act are synonyms, both plural nouns.

clue.text: Walrus, perhaps has to hurt crossing over

indicators.note: the over letter is crossed by the obligation word, sitting inside it

parts.note: must means has to
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
ache means hurt

explanation.surface: A walrus clambering across something must be in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Walrus' suggests the animal, but it is a style of drooping facial hair; 'crossing' places the over inside only the first word of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A walrus is a thick drooping style of facial hair on the upper lip, one example of the type.

clue.text: Type of sultanate on the east of Qatar

indicators.note: the sultanate is placed on, following, that letter
in an across word the east is the right-hand end, so the last letter of Qatar is taken

parts.note: Oman is a sultanate in the Arabian Peninsula

explanation.surface: A sort of sultanate lying to the east of Qatar, which Oman is.
explanation.walkthrough: The geography is a decoy: Type means a typeface.
explanation.definitionFit: Upright ordinary print, as opposed to italic, is a typeface style known by this name.

clue.text: Vote in case of reasonable performance

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside letters, here of reasonable

parts.note: a turn is a performance by an entertainer

explanation.surface: A vote is called in the event of a passable showing.
explanation.definitionFit: Electing someone to parliament is described as sending them back to the house, the usual verb for winning a seat.

clue.text: Watering hole of a bloodsucker seen outside Delhi regularly

indicators.note: the parasite is placed outside, around, the letters picked from Delhi

parts.note: a louse is a parasite that feeds on blood

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A bar in Delhi is spoiled by a mosquito or similar pest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes E and H from Delhi; 'seen outside' wraps LOUSE round them.
explanation.definitionFit: Watering hole is informal for a pub, an old-fashioned name for which is a place selling beer.

clue.text: Most important to net river and lake fish

indicators.note: netting means catching, so the chief word surrounds the next letters

parts.note: main means chief or most important

explanation.surface: The key thing is to land a fish from the river and lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A large game fish with a spear-like snout, a famous catch for sea anglers.

clue.text: Aid workers, looking embarrassed and annoyed

parts.note: someone embarrassed goes red in the face
cross means annoyed

explanation.surface: Relief staff appear embarrassed and irritated.
explanation.definitionFit: The international humanitarian movement whose staff give medical and disaster relief.

clue.text: America developing muscle and losing Democrat

indicators.note: developing means changing form, signalling the letters of muscle and are rearranged
losing means a letter is left out of the rearranged pool

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for Democrat in US politics

explanation.surface: America builds muscle while the Democrats lose ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developing' rearranges MUSCLE AND, and 'losing' drops D from that pool.
explanation.definitionFit: The bearded figure in a top hat is a national personification of the United States.

clue.text: Sets fire to joint as warning for sailors

parts.note: lights means sets fire to
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: Someone sets a joint alight as a signal to seamen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' suggests a cannabis cigarette but is the body joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A moored vessel carrying a beacon warns ships away from dangerous waters.

clue.text: Less enthusiastic about a new riddle

indicators.note: the cooler word goes about, around, the next two letters

parts.note: colder means less warm, less keen

explanation.surface: Someone is less keen on a fresh puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'riddle' looks like a puzzle but is a coarse sieve, as a verb or noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a large sieve, and a bowl with holes used for draining food is a kitchen sieve.

clue.text: 1950s youth from current book featuring in play

indicators.note: the current and the book feature inside the play word

parts.note: to toy is to play
an eddy is a swirling current of water

explanation.surface: A young man of the fifties appears in a play drawn from a recent book.
explanation.definitionFit: British youths of the 1950s who dressed in Edwardian-style drape jackets and drainpipe trousers were known by this name.

clue.text: Latent heat remaining should conceal drama

indicators.note: the words conceal, contain, the answer inside them across the word breaks

explanation.surface: A physics phrase about latent heat that remains should hide the drama.
explanation.definitionFit: Plays and dramatic art in general are known by this name, as in a career on the stage.

clue.text: Eliminates English jokes in speech

indicators.note: in speech means as spoken, so the jokes word is matched to a word sounding the same

parts.note: jests are jokes

explanation.surface: An English speaker drops the jokes from a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To discharge waste from the body, especially undigested food, is a technical verb for eliminating.

clue.text: Best resume novel, picking up quietly

indicators.note: the rearranged letters pick up, take in, the musical letter
novel means new, signalling the letters of resume are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: P is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: It is best to resume reading the novel, taking it up quietly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' rearranges RESUME and 'picking up' places P inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Highest in rank or quality is a synonym for the very best.

clue.text: Uranium in reactor upset union official

indicators.note: the chemical symbol goes in the rearranged letters
upset means knocked over or disturbed, signalling the letters of reactor are rearranged

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: An official is alarmed by uranium in a nuclear reactor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges REACTOR and 'in' places U inside. The union is the European Union, not a trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: An administrator in the European Union's bureaucracy, especially in Brussels, is known by this name.

clue.text: The chap wearing flat hat is vulgar

indicators.note: the man wears the hat, so it goes round him

parts.note: a cap is a soft flat hat
he refers to the chap, a male

explanation.surface: That man in the flat cap looks rather common.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteless and tawdry things are vulgar, of low quality and showy.

clue.text: Work in regressive places for bung

indicators.note: the work goes in the reversed word
regressive means going backwards, so the word for places is read in reverse

parts.note: puts means places
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Work in retrograde places calls for a plug.
explanation.walkthrough: OP for a work comes from opus, the numbering of a composer's works.
explanation.definitionFit: To bung a hole is to plug or block it, a phrasal verb with the same meaning.

clue.text: Sample initially put into sterile bag

indicators.note: that letter is put into the sterile word

parts.note: pure means clean, uncontaminated

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of sample is taken

explanation.surface: A lab sample is first placed into a sterile bag.
explanation.definitionFit: A small pouch for carrying money is a kind of bag.

clue.text: Spirit of writer transformed internally

indicators.note: only the inner pair of letters of the pen is changed, turned round in place

parts.note: a biro is a ballpoint pen, something that writes

explanation.surface: A writer's spirit is changed on the inside.
explanation.walkthrough: BIRO is a British brand name for a ballpoint pen; 'transformed internally' swaps its middle pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirit and vigour are synonyms for lively energy, especially in performance.

clue.text: Upset, a steward will admit discrimination

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so these words contain the answer

explanation.surface: A distressed flight attendant will confess to unfair treatment of passengers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' looks like an anagram signal but just supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Discrimination in the sense of discernment and fine judgement is good aesthetic sensibility.

clue.text: Unexpected contender may be mysterious, and worrying her so

parts.note: dark means mysterious, obscure

indicators.note: worrying means harassing, disturbing, so the letters of her so are rearranged

explanation.surface: A surprise rival might be enigmatic, and that troubles her greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor little known but who unexpectedly does well, from horse racing.

clue.text: Firearm found after lesson is an antique

indicators.note: the gun word comes after the lesson word

parts.note: a period is a school lesson
piece is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: A gun found after school is an old relic.
explanation.definitionFit: An object typical of a past era, especially furniture, is an old-fashioned item.
